Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted how to reduce uncontrolled variables and selected option A (checking gauges hourly), focusing on timing rather than controlling instrumentation across sites. Using identical rain gauges (option B) is the appropriate method to control for equipment-related variability. The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without following the instructed process to engage a specialist.
